mcq_fix.s: Consider the following pairs of air-quality standards (WHO AQG 2021 vs India NAAQS): 1. PM2.5 annual — WHO AQG 5 µg/m³; India NAAQS 40 µg/m³ 2. PM10 annual — WHO AQG 15 µg/m³; India NAAQS 60 µg/m³ 3. PM2.5 24-hour — WHO AQG 15 µg/m³; India NAAQS 60 µg/m³ Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?

patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: natural source (forest fires), main urban source (automobiles), CO reduces blood O2 capacity, NCAP launch year (2019), NCAP as industrial-emission initiative.
Acid rain is the most-repeated angle across PSCs: SO2 + NOx (trap options CO, CO2, O3, CH4, CFC); H2SO4 dominant; Taj marble damage by SO2.
AP tilt: APPCB action plan (123 ULBs/17 corporations), Varanasi top PM10 cut, Swachh Vayu Survekshan winner (Indore) as current affairs.
Other PSCs use NAQI pollutant lists, NCAP targets (20-30% by 2024; 40% by 2026), PRANA, cloud-seeding chemicals (silver iodide).
App MCQs lean heavily on multi-statement and 4-way match items with obscure figures (FGD 39/537, ammonium nitrate share, NAAQS SO2 sub-limits) far deeper than APPSC's direct one-liners.
